5 تبلّه : see 1. ―
-b2- And see 6. ―
-b3- Also (tropical:) He journeyed, or proceeded, or pursued his way, without any sign of the road, or any track, to guide him, (Az, K, TA,) without following the right course, (Az, TA,) and without asking [to be directed]. (K, TA.) ―
-b4- And (assumed tropical:) He prosecuted a search after a stray, or lost, beast. (JK, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
